put.description: Records how long the authenticated user has listened to a specific recording. Each call upserts a listening engagement: either a new row, or an update to an existing row when you reuse the recordingEngagementId value returned by a prior call for the same authenticated user, recording, organization, and listening session. Typical integrations send updates on a fixed interval while audio or video plays, and a final update when playback stops. All durations are in milliseconds.
